editions.homage: A front-facing portrait from ESCAPE VELOCITY — the first film.
editions.note: Edition 1. House rules: every eligible photograph appears at least once, and no photograph is used more than 4×. Film Canon was rebuilt under those rules (smaller grid than All). All and Film Canon used the same target portrait for this edition; future editions can pick different homage stills for each mode.
